source_corpus.saved_reels_format: instagram.com/reel/{shortcode}/ — shortcodes only, no titles or thumbnails in IG archive export

note: The IG archive does not expose reel titles or thumbnails as data — only shortcodes. So per-shortcode mapping to one of 16 archetypes requires fetching each URL (rate-limited + needs auth). Instead we map the 20 NAMED reference sites that the user pre-tagged in REELS[], plus provide a heuristic rubric the user (or future Claude session with browser MCP) can apply when surfacing new reels.

categorization_rubric.purpose: When a NEW saved reel surfaces and needs an archetype assignment, apply this rubric in order. Stop at first match.

decision_tree.if: ALL CAPS hero + sans-serif + red/white/black + manifesto tone
kanji or Japanese characters + amber/orange palette + members-only copy
kanji-style scrolling marquee + dark cinematic + serif
audio-reactive WAV viz + neon purple/pink + glow
cinematic full-bleed video hero + Bebas Neue / DM Sans
private jet / runway shots + serif + 'on-demand' copy
single product macro shot + ingredient mosaic + dark beige
stone architecture + landscape-led + DM Serif / Cormorant
atelier / mode / slow-fashion + cream + serif italic
logistics yard / autonomy / Linear-style UI + orange/green accent
shader experiment / creative-dev portfolio + mono font + red accent

deferred_work: Per-shortcode harvest: requires Chrome MCP + Instagram auth (NOT done — user must drive Instagram session per safety skill). Pipeline if user proceeds: (a) load each saved_posts URL via Claude_in_Chrome MCP, (b) extract caption + first-frame thumbnail, (c) run rubric in OCR, (d) write per-shortcode archetype label to data/saved-reels-classified.json. Cost: ~7,751 URLs × ~2s each = ~4h browser time. Reasonable to chunk into 500/run.
